name: control-prestamos-rosita
description: Sistema de gestión de préstamos basado en Control_Prestamos_Rosita_Registro_y_Rentabilidad.xlsx

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build --prefix backend && node desktop/run.mjs
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && npm run build --prefix backend && node desktop/prepare.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:setup: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
